convertibility_reason: SuperTrend indicator now supported by generator. Uses standard ATR-based SuperTrend as approximation for CCI-based variant. Entry on up/down signal buffers.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timing

other_exits: Opposite SuperTrend signal closes position (Up signal closes sell, Dn signal closes buy)
Double-check close: if both BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose enabled and SuperTrend buffer 1 (Dn trend) is active, force close buy; symmetric for sell with buffer 0 (Up trend)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots); BALANCE=fraction of balance; FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin; LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin considering loss; LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance considering loss.

custom_logic_notes: Signal is evaluated on bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous closed bar). Uses CCI-based SuperTrend variant (approximated with standard ATR-based SuperTrend in backtest). The EA uses 4 buffers: buffer 0=Up trend line, buffer 1=Dn trend line, buffer 2=Up signal (non-empty on buy signal bar), buffer 3=Dn signal (non-empty on sell signal bar). Original CCIPeriod=14, Level=0.
python_conversion_notes: Standard ATR-based SuperTrend approximation (period=14, multiplier=3.0) used in place of original CCI-based variant. Entry on direction flip signals (buffer 2/3). Signal bar offset of 1 means trades are on confirmed bars.
